title: QualityForge defect artifact v1
description: A single normalized failure, designed to extend Playwright's error-context.md rather than duplicate it. errorContextRef points at that file; everything here is what it does not carry: stable identity, run correlation, VCS context, evidence pointers, retry history and a flakiness verdict.

schemaVersion.description: Semantic version of this schema. A breaking change requires a new major.

id.description: Stable defect id derived from the test identity, so the same test yields the same id across runs.

runId.description: Identifier of the run that produced this defect. Groups all defects from one execution.

createdAt.description: When this artifact was written, ISO 8601 with timezone.

playwrightId.description: Playwright's opaque spec id. Stable within a Playwright version, not across versions.

file.description: Test file path, relative to the project root, POSIX separators.

line.description: 1-based line of the test declaration, as reported by the runner.

tags.description: Title or file tags, without the @ or # sigil.

message.description: The assertion or error message as reported by the runner, with terminal colour codes removed.

location.description: Where the assertion lives, which is usually not where the test failed.

snippet.description: Source excerpt around the failing line.

stack.description: Stack trace, when present. May be long; consumers should truncate.

errorContextRef.description: Relative path to Playwright's error-context.md. This artifact complements that file, it does not replace it.

evidence.description: Relative paths to captured evidence. Every field is optional: an absent trace on a local run with no retry is normal, not an error.

snapshot.description: Path to an aria or DOM snapshot, if one was taken.

report.description: Path to the HTML report entry point.

resultsDir.description: Output directory holding this failure's artifacts.

context.description: Where and how this ran. Deliberately excludes anything secret: no environment values, no credentials, no full URLs with query strings.

baseUrl.description: Origin under test, origin only. Query strings and credentials are stripped.

ci.description: Whether the run happened on CI.

retries.description: Retry count configured for the run.

durationMs.description: Total duration of the final attempt, milliseconds.

retryHistory.description: One entry per attempt, in order. Present only when retries actually happened.

flakiness.description: Classified from retry history within this run only. A verdict of 'unknown' is honest and expected when there was a single attempt.

verdict.description: flaky: passed on a retry. failing: failed every attempt. passedAfterRetry: passed on the final attempt. unknown: not enough attempts to decide.

signals.description: Console, uncaught-error and network evidence captured while the test ran. Absent when the test drove no page, or when nothing was captured. Values are redacted at the source: URLs keep scheme, host and path only, and console text has sensitive assignments stripped.

pageErrors.description: Uncaught exceptions thrown by page scripts.

dropped.description: How many entries hit the per-category cap. Present so a truncated capture never looks complete.

tags.description: Free-form labels applied by the collector or by configuration.
